This compound is identified as a target of cis-Isopinocamphone, which in turn is a known inhibitor of the transporter. The mechanism of action likely involves cis-Isopinocamphone binding to the transporter, thereby modulating its activity. The evidence supports a possible regulatory role of the compound in the transport process, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The relationship is supported by a moderate confidence score, indicating that further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
